scientific_integrity: Published general trapped-state classification and the three-dimensional cube example are acknowledged as antecedents. The new contribution is the explicit vertex-deleted Boolean cube edge formula and its sharp Hamming-depth asymptotic. Finite computations corroborate, but do not certify, the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for one initially occupied nonsink directed edge, iid dynamical percolation with open probability strictly between zero and one, a Grover coin and a single absorbing vertex.
The all-dimensional formula is for eventual absorption, not finite-time mixing; the asymptotic term requires fixed Hamming depth as dimension grows.
Earlier electrical-network work may implicitly include an equivalent effective-resistance identity; independent priority and scientific audit remain outstanding.
title: Exact Hamming-depth correction to percolated Grover absorption on hypercubes
